subject: delta(client): WF check the broadcast fee ceiling against the signed fees and refuse a node fee view that differs from them
note: The broadcast's fee ceiling now reads the debit of the signed transaction only: its amount plus the fees of its own signed transaction_fee. A confirmation whose node fee view is present and is not exactly the signed fees is refused at broadcast with fee_view_mismatch, a transfer refusal relays answer with 409 as not sent, before any lane, intent or dispatch record; the lease ends and nothing is broadcast.
